basic_details.job_title: IIT Tirupati Junior Library Executive Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Central Library of the Indian Institute of Technology Tirupati is filling 4 Junior Library Executive posts for two years on contract, with a consolidated stipend of Rs. 25,000 per month. Recent post-graduates in Library and Information Science who completed the Master's Degree in 2024, 2025 or 2026 can apply through an online Google form on or before 25 November 2026. The upper age limit is 30 years, and selection is by written test, practical test or interview.

content_sections.heading: IIT Tirupati Junior Library Executive at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

content_sections.heading: About IIT Tirupati Central Library
content_sections.text: The notice describes IIT Tirupati as a fast-growing, dynamic institute whose library is growing at the same pace. The Central Library is automated with RFID technology for faster circulation and better security, and it uses the open-source software KOHA for library management.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice advertises 4 posts of Junior Library Executive in the Central Library. The category break-up (2 + 1 + 1) adds up to the total of 4.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Both of the following qualifications are required for the Junior Library Executive post: Bachelor's Degree in any discipline with a minimum of 60% marks or a minimum CGPA of 6.0 on a 10-point scale or equivalent. Master's Degree in Library & Information Science with a minimum of 60% marks or a minimum CGPA of 6.0 on a 10-point scale or equivalent. Only candidates who completed the Master's Degree in Library & Information Science in 2024, 2025 or 2026 will be considered, along with meeting the other eligibility conditions. The upper age limit is 30 years; the notice prints no date for counting age. For discipline-specific details of eligibility, see the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The post is for two years on contract, with a consolidated monthly stipend of Rs. 25,000. Accommodation within the IIT Tirupati campus will be provided on payment basis, subject to availability. A Certificate of Experience will be given to those who complete at least one year of internship. The selected candidates should work six days a week and be willing to work in different shifts. The library timings printed in the notice are: Monday to Friday: 09.00 hrs to 24.00 hrs (09.00 hrs to 02.00 hrs of the next day during exam week). Mid-semester break, semester breaks and Saturdays: 09.00 hrs to 21.00 hrs. Public holidays: 09.00 hrs to 17.00 hrs.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Tirupati Junior Library Executive
content_sections.text: Interested candidates who meet the criteria apply through the online Google form ( https://forms.gle/NtQXmp8sTmJnQKBB9 ), which is available on the IIT Tirupati website ( https://www.iittp.ac.in ), on or before 25 November 2026. The documents are uploaded as indicated in the Google form. Recent passport size photograph Signature Bachelor's degree certificate MLIS marksheets and certificate Matriculation certificate (mentioning the date of birth)

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates will be selected based on their performance in the written test, practical test or interview. Eligible candidates will be informed about the selection process by email. The notice gives a tentative date of 10 December 2026 for the written test and the trade test or discussion. Mere fulfilment of the qualifications does not entitle a candidate to be called for the test.

faq.question: Q1. How many Junior Library Executive posts are vacant at IIT Tirupati?
faq.answer: There are 4 posts: 2 for UR, 1 for OBC-NCL and 1 for ST.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for IIT Tirupati Junior Library Executive?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online Google form is 25 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for IIT Tirupati Junior Library Executive?
faq.answer: A Bachelor's Degree in any discipline and a Master's Degree in Library & Information Science, each with a minimum of 60% marks or CGPA 6.0 on a 10-point scale or equivalent. The Master's must have been completed in 2024, 2025 or 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 30 years. Relaxation is up to 5 years for SC/ST, up to 3 years for OBC-NCL and 10 years for PwD candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a Junior Library Executive at IIT Tirupati?
faq.answer: The monthly stipend is Rs. 25,000, stated as consolidated.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Fill in the online Google form (https://forms.gle/NtQXmp8sTmJnQKBB9) available on the IIT Tirupati website (https://www.iittp.ac.in) by 25 November 2026, and upload the documents as indicated in the form.

faq.question: Q7. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Selection is based on performance in the written test, practical test or interview. Eligible candidates are informed by email, and the written test and trade test/discussion are tentatively fixed for 10 December 2026.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The post is for a period of two years on contract.

faq.question: Q9. Will TA/DA be paid for the test or interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be paid for attending the written test, practical test or interview.

faq.question: Q10. Is accommodation available for selected candidates?
faq.answer: Accommodation within the IIT Tirupati campus will be provided on payment basis, subject to availability.
